prompt:
This is a synthetic knowledge-pool benchmark. Answer only from the provided pool, even when it conflicts with real-world knowledge. Each fact has a serial number; a larger serial is newer and overrides an older conflicting fact about the same subject and relation. For multi-hop questions, resolve the newest fact separately at every hop. 

Use memory/history as needed. Return JSON with answer (a concise string) and evidence (fact serials and the chain).

What is the sport that Blair Walsh plays in which he is known for his position on the team?

Complete raw conversation archives are also available as text files in the workspace history/ directory. Native read_file and search_files tools can inspect them if useful.

Prior experience is available through native memory if useful. Decide whether and what to use.
